status: Integrated into 32 persistent-mark prefabs across eight pigments and connected to the existing direct-deposit and balloon-pop prefab data. Automated Unity checks passed; physical play feel and standalone-package acceptance are separate release evidence.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Unity persistent surface-paint decal texture atlas with four equal cells
Primary request: create an original 2-by-2 atlas of broad liquid-paint marks designed to overlap into continuous large-area coverage during repeated spray hits. Top-left: wide irregular puddle-like splat with a dense connected center, softly scalloped edge, and a few short satellite drops. Top-right: horizontally stretched directional smear with a thick leading pool, two or three short trailing tongues, and scattered droplets. Bottom-left: broad radial impact mark with a large solid center and short chunky lobes, avoiding long thin spokes. Bottom-right: asymmetric double-lobed spread shaped to bridge neighboring marks and hide gaps, with a dense center and a few small edge flecks.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted graphic game decal, energetic wet acrylic or latex paint, chunky readable silhouettes, mostly flat neutral white with subtle light-gray wet volume so runtime tinting remains clean.
Composition/framing: square canvas conceptually divided into four equal cells; one centered effect per cell; each effect fills roughly 78 to 88 percent of its cell; transparent padding between cells; no borders; no effect crosses into another cell.
Color palette: neutral white and very light gray only, designed for saturated runtime tinting.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha; strong opaque central coverage; irregular organic edges; no cast shadow; no colored background; no text; no logos; no characters; no weapon; no watermark; entirely original shapes.
Avoid: dry aerosol haze, fuzzy airbrush circles, tiny isolated stamps, excessive empty space, sharp star icons, thin sunburst spokes, identifiable assets or recognizable designs from Splatoon or any other named game.
